traced_basis: Both unchanged installed-public-trace replies associate paragraph-level role/shared-pool support with a mixed paragraph; established exact counting interpretation is separately present. Before-replay reproduces support then derived broad-pointer refusal.
before: For an outcome-specific source requirement, record counter_requirements with the actual and required capability filters, separately from thresholds, privacy or other obligations. Link exact automatic_limits and applicable operator_message_id.
after: For an outcome-specific source requirement, record counter_requirements with the actual and required capability filters. Link each exact automatic_limits root or counter path; a broad approval pointer is only surrounding context. A paragraph operator_message_id supports that passage, not automatically every counter. Optionally put an exact operator_message_id on each counter for its own scoped support. Runner may associate a uniquely established counting interpretation when that component reference is omitted; an explicit wrong reference is refused. Mixed passages retain their other claims and checks: a counter comparison cannot discharge thresholds, windows, conditions, privacy, effects or other obligations.
scope: Representation guidance and optional per-counter support only. No fixture name, source line, message number, rescue sentence or new policy meaning added.
schema_before: counter_requirements items: path, current_capability, required_capability; no component-specific support field
schema_after: Optional counter_requirements[].operator_message_id: exact indexed supporting decision for that counter; paragraph operator_message_id remains independent. Explicit wrong support is refused.
context_before: Retained counting interpretation taken only from the enclosing source passage and its supporting clarification.
context_after: When saved host components exist, reuse their original exact scoped source interpretation and question/answer only after source/program/history/actual-clarification binding checks. De-duplicate identical original records; never use the new paragraph citation to replace the decision.
